mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions and rising corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.0%), or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) from the prior month indicates a broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or the interaction effect's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), a decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when RSAFS declines, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 3.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 is positive, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a dual shock of monetary tightening and economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and UNRATE both rise from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or the interaction effect's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply-side constraints and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during high inflation when INDPRO declines, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
